name: Dandred's Fold
summary: Syndicate outlaws hold Dandred's Fold on Lordamere Lake's northwestern shore. The farmstead and manor shelter Lord Aliden Perenolde and his co-conspirators. The Horde and Alliance watch the estate for different reasons.

sections.title: A Noble Safe Haven Fallen to Outlaws
sections.body: On the western edge of the Uplands, Dandred's Fold stands beside Lordamere Lake, apart from the surrounding country. The estate was once tranquil and may have belonged to an Alteraci noble named Dandred. After Alterac fell, the Syndicate turned it into a fortified refuge. Its assassins and enforcers patrol the grounds. They keep Southshore authorities and the Forsaken across the lake from the fallen nobility sheltered within.

sections.title: A Nexus of Intrigues
sections.body: Lord Aliden Perenolde leads the Syndicate and makes Dandred's Fold his base. His mistress, Elysa, is with him there. Nagaz has also made his place at the manor. A rogue Shadow Council orc of the Argus Wake, he brokers dark pacts with the human brigands. This alliance has drawn the attention of Southshore's magistrates and Horde champions.

faq.answer: The Syndicate occupies Dandred's Fold. It is an aristocratic criminal network led by Alterac's deposed nobles, and its assassins and enforcers guard the estate under Lord Aliden Perenolde.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this estate?
aliases: why horde go to dandreds fold
faq.answer: The Horde targets the manor to strike down Lord Aliden Perenolde and retrieve a stolen keepsake. It is the heirloom necklace of Taretha Foxton, Thrall's childhood savior and confidante.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance send adventurers here?
faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb of Southshore sends Alliance agents to eliminate Nagaz. He is a dangerous member of the Argus Wake cult who colludes with the Syndicate outlaws.
No confirmed account identifies Dandred. The estate bears his name, but its original owner is unknown.

angles.text: For the Horde, Dandred's Fold is personal. Warchief Thrall seeks the return of Taretha Foxton's necklace.
The Alliance cannot tolerate an alliance between human outlaws and the demonic Argus Wake. Magistrate Henry Maleb orders strikes against the estate.
